name: Vincent van Hossen
original_name: ヴィンセント＝ファン・ホッセン
source: The father of Maria and Sylvia. He is a respectable figure in society and a supporter of the Arima Group. Teppei's grandfather, Isshin Arima, places great trust in Vincent and thus he chose his daughter, Sylvia, to be Teppei's fiancée. Vincent is calm and collected no matter the situation. He really wants Teppei to be his son-in-law and the father of his grandchildren
